name: bugagent
description: Capture bugs with approval, check possible duplicates, and look up reports in bugAgent using an existing bugAgent license.

interface.longDescription: For teams using an existing bugAgent license: capture a bug after reviewing and approving its draft, check possible duplicates, and look up reports in authorized projects. Screenshot descriptions can be included as text; image uploads must be completed in the ticket UI. Administration, deletion, automation, and test-case creation are not supported.
